packageRules.description: The engine regression corpus is pinned to vulnerable versions deliberately. Its manifests are fixtures, not dependencies: testdata/corpus/expected.yaml asserts that a vulnerability IS reported against lodash 4.17.20 and minimist 1.2.5, so upgrading them does not fix anything -- it removes the thing the scanners are being tested against, and the corpus fails with 'no vulnerability reported against a version pinned to be vulnerable'. Nothing here is built, installed or shipped.
